$comment: Dependency licence policy (#16 C.2). `allow` is what may enter the tree without a second look; it is also the allow-licenses list of .github/dependency-review-config.yml, and check:licenses fails when the two differ. Anything else, GPL and LGPL included, needs an entry under `exceptions` with the reason: Kuutti is AGPL-3.0 with an App Store exception (LICENSE-EXCEPTION), and a copyleft library in the mobile bundle without an equivalent permission would take the store distribution away again. An exception names the package and the exact licence string, so a licence change brings the question back.

exceptions.name: @csstools/color-helpers
exceptions.reason: MIT No Attribution: MIT without the attribution duty. Test tooling (jsdom), not distributed.

exceptions.name: @csstools/css-syntax-patches-for-csstree
exceptions.reason: MIT No Attribution. Test tooling (jsdom), not distributed.

exceptions.name: @expo/logger
exceptions.reason: Transitive of eas-cli, a command-line tool that runs on developers' machines and in CI. Never bundled into the app, the API or the admin panel, and not redistributed by us.

exceptions.name: @sentry/cli
exceptions.reason: A native command-line binary that uploads source maps (#11). It is installed through @sentry/react-native, a dependency of the app, but only that package's build scripts call it: Metro cannot bundle a binary, the API image does not contain it, and we do not redistribute it. FSL converts to MIT two years after each release.

exceptions.name: @sentry/cli-darwin
exceptions.reason: Platform binary of @sentry/cli on macOS; see @sentry/cli.

exceptions.name: @sentry/cli-linux-arm64
exceptions.reason: Platform binary of @sentry/cli on the arm64 CI runners; see @sentry/cli.

exceptions.name: @sentry/cli-linux-x64
exceptions.reason: Platform binary of @sentry/cli on the x64 CI runners; see @sentry/cli.

exceptions.name: caniuse-lite
exceptions.reason: Browser support data read by browserslist at build time. Data, not code that ships; attribution is kept by the package itself.

exceptions.name: @segment/loosely-validate-event
exceptions.reason: No licence field in package.json; the package carries an MIT LICENSE file. Transitive of eas-cli, not distributed.

exceptions.name: golden-fleece
exceptions.reason: No licence field in package.json. Its LICENSE file is a short permissive licence by the author (use, copy, change, distribute and sell, with the licence text kept), not an SPDX-listed one. Transitive of eas-cli, not distributed.

exceptions.name: qrcode-terminal
exceptions.reason: Apache-2.0 spelled without the SPDX hyphen. Transitive of eas-cli, which prints QR codes in the terminal; not distributed.
